nodes.statement: A finite nonzero reference energy in the same regulated four-dimensional pure-YM family with an independent continuum proof.

cross_debt_dependencies.effect: The reference scale must survive the same controlled four-dimensional continuum trajectory.
The target limiting Hamiltonian remains reconstruction-dependent if the OS route is used.

false_proof_firewalls: Do not define the physical scale using the target mass gap itself.
Do not use a reference observable whose nonzero continuum value is proved only from the desired gap.
Do not infer physical positivity from a dimensionless target/reference ratio unless the reference scale is itself finite and nonzero.
Do not import a new external reference-scale theorem outside the governed source route.
current_frontier: The abstract D001 scaling machinery is now reduced to one substantive four-dimensional application object: a finite nonzero non-circular reference scale on the actual pure-YM cutoff trajectory, together with the actual regulated operator identifications and a positive target/reference gap ratio.
certification_boundary: R006 is an uncertified Solve theorem candidate. It does not establish D001, D003, or the terminal Yang-Mills problem.
